# CANDIDATE: PREFLIGHT_BASELINE_SANITY_CHECK

**Filed:** 2026-07-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a pre-flight gate that checks the baseline win rate against the gate floor prevents the research loop from proceeding when the gate floor is set too high relative to a simple baseline, avoiding wasted compute on doomed research configurations.

## Mechanism

At the start of each iteration in autoresearch/loop.py, run a baseline backtest (using the current engine with all candidate gates disabled) on the last 30 trading days of OPRA data. Compute the win rate (WR) of this baseline. If the gate floor (a parameter in the research loop, e.g., `min_wr_to_proceed`) exceeds the baseline WR by more than 10 percentage points (i.e., `gate_floor - baseline_wr > 0.10`), then abort the loop and print an error message showing both values.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** N/A (research loop change, no account size assumption).
2. **Sample bias:** Uses last 30 days of data for baseline backtest; overfit risk low as it is a sanity check, not a strategy candidate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed for this gate).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (baseline backtest assumed to use OPRA cache; real-fills validation not performed).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst case: Baseline backtest WR unusually low due to noise, causing unnecessary abort and halting research.
   - Max drawdown: N/A (no P&L impact).
   - Blow-up scenario: N/A (no order placement).
6. **Concentration:** N/A (no P&L generated).
